description: This PHP class defines an AWS SDK client for interacting with the API Gateway service. It extends the base AwsClient, adding specific method annotations for API operations and customizing request headers.

classes.name: ApiGatewayClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS API Gateway, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting API Gateway resources. It also customizes request headers with an 'Accept' header.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client, calls the parent constructor, and appends a build step to add the 'Accept: application/json' header to each request.

methods.name: _add_accept_header
methods.description: A static method that returns a handler to add an 'Accept: application/json' header to outgoing requests.
